title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express E/A in terms of the total spin operator S.

title: Eigenvalues and Degeneracy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately state the eigenvalues of E/A and their corresponding degeneracies.

title: Use of Spin Operators
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of how to manipulate spin operators in the context of the problem.

title: Correctness of Calculations
description: Important Criteria: The student must show correct calculations leading to the final expressions for E/A.

title: Clarity of Presentation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present their work clearly and logically, making it easy to follow their reasoning.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in the expressions for E/A and its eigenvalues.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms are dimensionally consistent throughout their solution.
